name: kiln-next
description: Classes for the Kiln runtime, under the holding name kiln-next until the old kiln plugin retires. Ships the Crafter (changes the artifact), the Designer (the shape skill: a three-lens design dialogue that ends at a written decision), the Planner (turns a decision into a ticket plan with rerunnable checks), the Inspector (rules once per build job on conformance to the plan and names the consequence it observed), and the Prospector (a bounded researcher that invokes the research skill by name). Carries the consequence policy and the borrowed-review pins the job and fire skills read.
